name: Neighborhood Moms' Parenting Exchange Group
last_message: Be very careful with Pinduoduo formula sellers during Spring Festival sales!

messages.content: Sisters, has anyone bought NutriGrow formula from the Pinduoduo group buy? The price is amazing - 399 per can!
I joined that group last week! Already received 6 cans. Packaging looks identical to the ones from JD. Saved over 1000 RMB! 😊

Wait, be careful! My cousin's baby had a severe allergic reaction to 'NutriGrow' from Pinduoduo last month. Turned out to be counterfeit - the batch number didn't verify in the official system. She's still dealing with the hospital bills. 😰
Oh no! How can you tell if it's fake? Mine has QR codes...

Fake ones can have QR codes too! You need to scan it through the official NutriGrow WeChat mini-program, not just any random QR scanner. My cousin's showed 'batch number not found' when she checked after the reaction. The Pinduoduo seller refused refund because she'd opened 2 cans already.
This is scary! I almost joined that group buy yesterday. The 'limited time' pressure made me want to rush. Good thing I waited.

I asked my pediatrician about this. She said during Spring Festival sales, counterfeit baby products spike because sellers know parents are trying to save money on bulk purchases. She only recommends official flagship stores on JD or Tmall - the ones with blue 'Official' badges.
But official stores are so expensive! 580 per can vs 399 - that's almost 200 RMB difference. For 15 cans that's 3000 RMB savings! 😭
My cousin's hospital bill was 8000 RMB for the allergic reaction treatment. Plus the emotional trauma of seeing her baby suffer. Not worth any savings. 😢
Exactly. My doctor said if the price is more than 15% below official retail (580 RMB), it's a major red flag. 399 is 31% below - way too suspicious.

@He Meilan Right now only Xiaobao has this, it's not a group issue. It could be an individual allergy or another cause, and I'd suggest taking him to a doctor for a detailed check. Once Xiaobao recovers, he will need a doctor's certificate before returning to school. Wishing Xiaobao a speedy recovery!
Mrs. He, my child had something similar before, and we later found it was a formula allergy. Have you changed formula recently?

@Mrs. Zhang Yes! We switched to a new formula at the end of February (NutriGrow HA Pro). Since switching, he's had three fevers this month, which never happened so often before. I'm torn about whether to switch back, but I've forgotten the brand name of the old formula 😓

That's very likely the formula! When my child kept running fevers after switching formula, the doctor said it was protein allergy. I'd suggest stopping the new formula right away and seeing whether the symptoms improve. We switched to BabyComfort Sensitive then, which is designed for allergy-prone kids, and it worked well.
